title: Nourishing Crisp Indian Lamb Vada Pav
description: A winey and crisp crowd-pleaser Indian dish featuring lamb kidney, this vada pav is a nut-free-friendly option that is sure to delight, originating from the Maharashtrian cuisine
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pan and saute for another minute.
Add the diced lamb kidney to the pan and cook until it is browned.
Add the chopped green chili and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomato to the pan and cook until it is soft.
Season the mixture with salt and lemon juice.
Toast the pav bread and spread a layer of the lamb mixture on each bread.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee in a pan over medium heat and crisp the vada pav for 2 minutes on each side.
